From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fraud review: BrightMesh repeated-credit signals

Team —

I ran the signals over the attachments. Summary:
- Cross-account linkage: high probability (shared IP ranges and identical API key patterns).
- Promo-replay indicators: identical prompt signatures and truncated session lengths across the three accounts.
- Manual checks: billing domain brightmesh.ai is valid, but procurement email used on one account is a generic gmail address.

Recommendation: hold approval until procurement provides corporate PO on letterhead + confirmation of unique teams (org chart or Slack workspace invite). If procurement pushes, consider a conditional one-time grant (25k tokens) under an anti-abuse covenant: no additional grants until live customer proof.

If Sales wants to offer anything more customer-friendly, Ops should mark the org as under review and block further auto-grants until cleared.

Neha Kapoor
Fraud & Risk Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fraud review: BrightMesh repeated-credit signals

All —

I agree with Neha's conservative approach. We should protect the promo program. Proposed compromise:
- Offer a conditional 25k token grant immediately to unblock the PoC, with a documented covenant (no further grants until procurement PO + org chart).
- Add a 30-day probation flag on the account that requires review before any automation grants.
- If BrightMesh provides clear enterprise procurement evidence within 14 days, escalate to approve the additional 25k.

Ben, please prepare the covenant language and the probation flag in Ops. Monica — communicate this to Ale with clear ask items. Karthik — happy for you to send the final.

Lauren Bishop
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: BrightMesh credit replay — approval hold & evidence request

Aleksandar —

Thanks for the patience. We reviewed the request and put a hold while we validated some cross-account signals. To move forward quickly, we can provide a one-time 25k token evaluation grant now under the following conditions:

- Procurement: send a signed PO on BrightMesh letterhead OR a confirmation email from a company procurement domain (not generic gmail) within 14 days.
- Team proof: supply an org chart or invite link to your Slack workspace showing the two pilot teams within 14 days.
- Probation: your account will be on a 30-day probation; no further auto-grants until requirements are met and Ops clears the account.

If you provide the documents within 14 days we will prioritize an additional 25k tokens. If not, all further grants will be paused and we will close the request.

Sending this to help you move forward while protecting promotions. Let me know if procurement needs a sample PO template or if you want a short call to coordinate.

Best —
